review.facts: Every factual sentence maps to a row of the merged fact key (F1-F20) in docs/assets/jet-suit/SOURCES.md. The key merges two independent AI model web fact-checks (GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini 3.8 Flash).
review.verdict: An independent read-only review of the same JSON bytes gave PUBLIC-OK for the 7 step stills and story.mp4, with hero.png excluded. That review used renders from the PR #37 head (0a53cc6dec88d0584041c69eb18357d7c314b165) before its merge.
review.differenceFromReviewedRenders: Between 0a53cc6 and this commit the only renderer change is the subtitle line (medium weight, 85 % ink, was regular 60 %). The subtitle now names jet-suit.json, not the earlier working file name. All 7 new stills were inspected one by one: labels, captions, arrows and framing match the reviewed stills. A pixel diff also shows small rendering differences in under 1.7 % of colour channels; no label, arrow or caption moved.

revisions.why: The new strict anchor checks refused the reviewed file twice. (1) annotation.anchor.hidden: in step 6 the label lComb ("Combustion chamber") had its dot on the cut casing wall (back.casing was the first surface on the line of sight). (2) annotation.anchor.off: the step 1 label lPilot ("Schematic pilot") named the helmet, but its point lay 2 mm outside the helmet's box and inside the visor, on the far side of the head from the step 1 camera (the earlier render drew its dot hollow, as occluded, on the head's outline).
revisions.change: lComb anchor {"part": "back.combustor", "offset": [30, 0, 148]} -> {"part": "back.combustor", "offset": [0, -30, 148]} (a point on the cut face, inside the annular chamber); lPilot anchor {"part": "helmet", "offset": [0, -110, 0]} -> {"part": "helmet", "offset": [0, 108, 0]} (the back of the helmet, which faces the step 1 camera). No text, fact, part, step or camera changed.
revisions.engine: morrowdock/martygraphics branch feat/strict-label-anchors (PR #40) on origin/main 3624a03494047a7b0c495ac0663f0d40ea021e04. The branch changes the check only; the render code is the code of 3624a03.

revisions.review: The builder inspected the new step-1.png (the dot is solid, on the back of the helmet) and the story hold frames at 5.0 and 52.0 s (step 1 and step 6; text sharp, step 6 dot inside the copper combustion chamber). The independent PUBLIC-OK review above covers the earlier bytes; independent reviews of PR #40 checked the lComb change and an earlier replacement set. The lPilot change was found and made in PR #40's fourth round.
revisions.comparison: CoreGraphics RGB comparison of each new still with the 70bfc47 still it replaces, in top-left image coordinates. Step 1: channels differ by more than 24/255 only inside the box x 458-842, y 131-187 (the moved "Schematic pilot" label, leader and dot, up to 214/255); outside it 2,089 channels differ, by at most 2/255. Step 6: channels differ by more than 24/255 only inside the box x 329-626, y 369-437 (the moved "Combustion chamber" label, up to 240/255); outside it 119,706 channels differ, by at most 22/255, spread over x 224-1277, y 2-796. Steps 2-5 and 7: 2,945 to 64,301 channels (0.10 % to 2.09 %) differ, by at most 11/255. Two renders of this build differ by up to 11/255 in up to about 2 % of channels, so the stills are not byte-reproducible; these small differences are render noise.
